pages.en: It is Tom's birthday. Mum puts him next to the kitchen door with a ruler. "Stand up straight, Tom!" she says.
pages.zh: 今天是 Tom 的生日。妈妈让他站到厨房门边，拿着一把尺子。“站直了，Tom！”她说。
pages.scene: Tom standing very straight against a kitchen door frame, Mum holding a ruler flat on his head, Lily watching and smiling, a birthday balloon nearby.

pages.en: "You are one metre and fifteen centimetres," says Mum. "That's five centimetres more than last year!"
pages.zh: “你有一米一十五厘米，”妈妈说，“比去年高了五厘米！”
pages.scene: Mum making a small pencil mark on the door frame above an older mark, Tom turning around to look up at it with big eyes.

pages.en: Then Dad finds out how heavy Max is. "Seven kilogrammes!" laughs Tom. Max just wants some birthday cake.
pages.zh: 接着爸爸给 Max 称了称有多重。“七公斤！”Tom 笑着说。Max 只想吃点生日蛋糕。
pages.scene: Dad holding Max on a bathroom weighing machine, Tom laughing, Max looking at a birthday cake on the table, Mum and Lily laughing.

questions.q: Tom is taller than last year.
How many centimetres more is Tom?
